name: Louise Upston
story: As Land Information Minister, Louise Upston announced the inaugural New Zealand Spatial Excellence Awards in November 2014. The government release records the awards as a joint undertaking between the spatial profession, business and government and identifies LINZ’s Geospatial Virtual Field Trip for Schools as the People & Community winner.
